With the launch of Europe’s first ever private Personal Training studio in Mayfair 30 years ago, Matt Roberts pioneered an entire industry and became known as the **_UK’s foremost fitness_** and **_performance expert._**

His roster of high profile clients, influential partnerships and media work have seen him transform the way personal training and fitness are perceived today and his passion for innovation is stronger now than ever.

As a _**serial entrepreneur, bestselling author**_ and _**in-demand speaker**_, Matt is the industry name that everyone who is anyone calls upon for unparalleled training, expert guidance and guaranteed results.

![](https://mattroberts.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/matt-x2-images.png)

"Having been a keen sportsman through school and university, I found myself at 45, overweight and as unfit as I had been in my entire adult life. Matt and his team helped me overcome some underlying imbalances and injuries, and then build a programme that kept me motivated towards my goals."

Dave, 51

"Before I started training with Matt, I felt stuck in a cycle of low energy and inconsistent workouts. Within the first month, I noticed a huge difference, not just in my strength, but in my confidence. For the first time in my life, I actually saw myself as a fit and healthy person, capable of living stronger for longer."

Amy, 45

![](https://mattroberts.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/x3-images.png)

## EVOLUTION LONGEVITY CLUBS

Having successfully operated multiple wellbeing facilities and retreats across the globe for over 25 years, Matt took the decision to bring everything together in one unique space.

In 2019, he founded Matt Roberts Evolution, a holistic collaboration focussed on optimising health, performance and longevity, designed with the clear goal of helping our clients to _**live younger, fitter and stronger for longer**_

Driven by his vision to have a range of luxury longevity services working in tandem under one roof, Matt and his team of expert coaches and clinicians provide uniquely optimised transformations for those they serve.

[EXPLORE](https://mattroberts.co.uk/locations/)

## The Longevity Lab at Evolution

VO2 Test

Knowing your VO2 level score and how to train to make it as high as possible is vital for a long, healthy and active life.

Our test is performed using KORR Medical Technologies equipment which deliver the most accurate data available. Alongside VO2 we are also able to measure MOXY levels and Metabolic efficiency data.

A good VO2 score is considered the gold standard in the search for a long healthy and active life. To find out more or to book in for your test, click the button below.

[Learn More](https://mattroberts.co.uk/vo2-performance-profile/)

![Blood Work](https://mattroberts.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/8.png)

[Blood Work](https://mattroberts.co.uk/#modal-popup-programme-2)

Blood Work

Blood data is the foundation of each clients programme at Matt Roberts Evolution, with our standard analysis being an 82 bio-marker test that covers all the key health areas.

Hormone health, Lipid Profiling, Digestive health, Thyroid Function, Blood Sugar Management, Liver Health and Cardiovascular risk factors are all are closely monitored, kept under control by frequent blood testing.

Knowledge is power when it comes to your health and the perfect starting point is a well-rounded set of blood data. To find out more or to book in for your test, click the button below.

[Learn More](https://mattroberts.co.uk/blood-chemistry-profile/)

Bone Health

Using cutting edge Echolight REMS and BioDensity technologies, our Bone Health Clinic provides a next-generation diagnostic and training process for detecting and reversing osteoporosis and other bone-related conditions.

When it comes to your bones, early diagnosis of potentially life-shortening conditions is vital for ensuring greater longevity. To find out more or to book in for your test, click the button below.

[Learn More](https://mattroberts.co.uk/bone-health-clinic/)

[Skin Health](https://mattroberts.co.uk/#modal-popup-programme-4)

Skin Health

Your skin tells a story. Using advanced imaging technology, we visualise all skin lesions with high magnification to map your moles, look for sun damage and identify early signs of skin cancer for proactive care.

By comparing your baseline scan to future scans, our AI-assisted technology detects even the subtlest changes over time, ensuring any new developments are caught early. To find out more or to book in for your test, click the button below.

[Learn More](https://mattroberts.co.uk/skin-intelligence-profile/)

## Tailored Training Programmes

![Bone Density](https://mattroberts.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/3.png)

[Bone Density](https://mattroberts.co.uk/#modalx-popup-programme-1)

Bone Density

**COMING SOON**

**The Plan**

We don’t guess when it comes to your skeletal integrity; we measure it by starting with a medical-grade EchoLight REMS scan.

By identifying your T-score and Fragility score, the specific areas of vulnerability in your hips or lumbar spine, we can create a personalised roadmap. This isn’t a one-size-fits-all fitness routine; it is a clinical strategy designed to minimise fracture risk and maximise your physical freedom.

**The Process**

Building bone is a biological marathon, not a sprint. We focuses on the science of Osteogenic Loading to trigger bone growth, by applying specific levels of force to your skeletal system that regular walking or light weights simply can’t reach.

Under the guidance of our specialists, you will move through a series of controlled, high-impact movements and resistance protocols. We monitor your progress session-by-session, ensuring you hit the mechanical stress that signals your body to lay down new, mineral-rich bone tissue.

**The Programme**

Consistency is the secret ingredient to longevity and a stronger version of yourself. Beyond the gym floor, we integrate:

- **Nutritional Optimisation:** Ensuring your internal chemistry supports the rebuilding process.

- **Balance & Fall Prevention:** Training your nervous system to protect your new foundation.

- **Periodic Re-Scanning:** Every 12 months, we repeat your scan to provide objective proof of your progress


[Enquire](https://mattroberts.co.uk/contact/)

![Menopause](https://mattroberts.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/1.png)

[Menopause](https://mattroberts.co.uk/#modalx-popup-programme-2)

Menopause

**COMING SOON**

**The Plan**

Navigating pre, peri, and menopause doesn’t have to mean accepting muscle loss, bone deterioration, and low energy. Our 16-week programme is designed to help you thrive through this transition with targeted training, nutrition, and medical support.

**The Process**

Starting with comprehensive blood work to assess hormonal changes and a bone density scan, our team led by Dr. Nicky Keay and clinical dietitian Nicola Marsh design personalised supplement, medication and diet protocols tailored to your needs.

**The Programme**

The training programme builds strength and bone density through full-body resistance work, power training, and plyometrics based on the proven LIFTMOR protocols, with progress retested at 8 and 16 weeks to track improvements.

Feeling full of life and energy should be normal at every age and this programme makes that possible.

[Enquire](https://mattroberts.co.uk/contact/)

![GLP-1](https://mattroberts.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/4.png)

[GLP-1](https://mattroberts.co.uk/#modalx-popup-programme-3)

GLP-1

**COMING SOON**

The Plan

After years working with GLP-1 clients, we’ve identified the exact training protocols needed to maximise fat loss while building strength and cardiovascular fitness, the only way to turn GLP-1 benefits into sustainable results.

**The Process**

Working with our partners at Harley St Docs, we’ve designed a unique GLP-1 programme that addresses what most others miss – comprehensive medical oversight, personalised nutrition and structured training to preserve muscle and ensure long-term success.

**The Programme**

This intensive 16-week programme requires three gym sessions weekly plus cardio training, with regular dietary and medical reviews, ensuring every goal achieved is one you can maintain for life.

[Enquire](https://mattroberts.co.uk/contact/)

![Male 50 Plus](https://mattroberts.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2.png)

[Male 50 Plus](https://mattroberts.co.uk/#modalx-popup-programme-4)

Male 50 Plus

**COMING SOON**

The Plan

Specifically designed to combat the 2% annual muscle loss and accelerated strength decline men experience after 50, this programme combines our years of experience with the latest research to reverse aging effects.

**The Process**

Starting with in-depth assessments of strength, mobility, VO2 Max, plus comprehensive blood work (thyroid, liver, hormones, testosterone), liver markers, and bone density tests, we create a personalised training plan supported by medical-grade nutrition, hormone optimisation, and peptide protocols.

**The Programme**

The programme includes in-gym sessions, guided at-home workouts, strict cardiovascular protocols tracked via Whoop, and delivers a body that moves well, looks good, and performs at its peak—requiring high commitment but delivering transformative results.

[Enquire](https://mattroberts.co.uk/contact/)

[![Podcasts](https://mattroberts.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/ELP-HP-1.png)](https://mattroberts.co.uk/podcast/)

## Evolution  Lab Podcast

Launched by Matt in 2022, The Evolution Lab podcast was created to **_guide_** and **_inspire millions_** to live their longest, strongest lives as the fittest, healthiest and most vital versions of themselves.

Through his conversations with some of the greatest thinkers, clinicians, coaches and researchers in the fields of health, performance and longevity, Matt is on a mission to help listeners **_defy their age_**, realise their potential and live as well as they can for as long as they can.

[EXPLORE](https://mattroberts.co.uk/podcast/)

Bone Density

COMING SOON

The Plan

We don’t guess when it comes to your skeletal integrity; we measure it by starting with a medical-grade EchoLight REMS scan.

By identifying your T-score and Fragility score, the specific areas of vulnerability in your hips or lumbar spine, we can create a personalised roadmap. This isn’t a one-size-fits-all fitness routine; it is a clinical strategy designed to minimise fracture risk and maximise your physical freedom.

The Process

Building bone is a biological marathon, not a sprint. We focuses on the science of Osteogenic Loading to trigger bone growth, by applying specific levels of force to your skeletal system that regular walking or light weights simply can’t reach.

Under the guidance of our specialists, you will move through a series of controlled, high-impact movements and resistance protocols. We monitor your progress session-by-session, ensuring you hit the mechanical stress that signals your body to lay down new, mineral-rich bone tissue.

The Programme

Consistency is the secret ingredient to longevity and a stronger version of yourself. Beyond the gym floor, we integrate:

  • Nutritional Optimisation: Ensuring your internal chemistry supports the rebuilding process.

  • Balance & Fall Prevention: Training your nervous system to protect your new foundation.

  • Periodic Re-Scanning: Every 12 months, we repeat your scan to provide objective proof of your progress
